WLAN_connectivity.label: WLAN connectivity
WLAN_connectivity.description: This object specifies resources to enable a device to connect to a WLAN bearer.

Enable.label: Enable
Enable.description:
0: Disabled
1: Enabled
Enable / Disable interface
When disabled radio must also be disabled

Radio_Enabled.label: Radio Enabled
Radio_Enabled.description:
0: Disabled
1: 2.4 GHz
2: 5 GHz
3: 0.9 GHz
4: 3.7 GHz
5: 45 GHz
6: 60 GHz

BSSID.label: BSSID
BSSID.description: The MAC address of the interface, in hexadecimal form.

SSID.label: SSID
SSID.description: The Service Set Identifier for this interface.

Broadcast_SSID.label: Broadcast SSID
Broadcast_SSID.description: 0: Do not broadcast SSID 1: Broadcast SSID

Beacon_Enabled.label: Beacon Enabled
Beacon_Enabled.description: 0: Do not broadcast beacons 1: Broadcast beacons

Channel.label: Channel
Channel.description: The current radio channel in use by this interface.

Channels_In_Use.label: Channels In Use
Channels_In_Use.description:
Array of channels which the access point has determined are ‘in use’.
Including any channels in-use by access point itself.

Regulatory_Domain.label: Regulatory Domain
Regulatory_Domain.description:
802.11d Regulatory Domain String. 
First two octets are ISO/IEC 3166-1 two-character country code. 
The third octet is either " " (all environments), "O" (outside) or "I" (inside).

WPA_Pre_Shared_Key.label: WPA Pre Shared Key
WPA_Pre_Shared_Key.description: WPA/WPA2 Key expressed as a hex string. Write - Only.

WEP_Key_Index.label: WEP Key Index
WEP_Key_Index.description: Index of the default WEP key.

WEP_Key_1.label: WEP Key 1
WEP_Key_1.description:
WEP Key 1 expressed as a hexadecimal string.
10 Bytes for a 40 Bit key
26 Bytes for a 104 Bit key

WEP_Key_2.label: WEP Key 2
WEP_Key_2.description:
WEP Key 2 expressed as a hexadecimal string.
10 Bytes for a 40 Bit key
26 Bytes for a 104 Bit key

WEP_Key_3.label: WEP Key 3
WEP_Key_3.description:
WEP Key 3 expressed as a hexadecimal string.
10 Bytes for a 40 Bit key
26 Bytes for a 104 Bit key

WEP_Key_4.label: WEP Key 4
WEP_Key_4.description:
WEP Key 4 expressed as a hexadecimal string.
10 Bytes for a 40 Bit key
26 Bytes for a 104 Bit key

MAC_Control_Enabled.label: MAC Control Enabled
MAC_Control_Enabled.description: 0: Any Client MAC Address accepted 1: Client MAC address must exist in MACAddressList

MAC_Address_List.label: MAC Address List
MAC_Address_List.description: Array of allowed client MAC addresses, in hexadecimal form.

Total_Bytes_Sent.label: Total Bytes Sent
Total_Bytes_Sent.description: Total number of bytes sent via this interface

Total_Bytes_Received.label: Total Bytes Received
Total_Bytes_Received.description: Total number of bytes received via this interface

Total_Packets_Sent.label: Total Packets Sent
Total_Packets_Sent.description: Total packets sent via this interface

Total_Packets_Received.label: Total Packets Received
Total_Packets_Received.description: Total packets received via this interface

Transmit_Errors.label: Transmit Errors
Transmit_Errors.description: Total number of packets which could not be transmitted because of errors.

Receive_Errors.label: Receive Errors
Receive_Errors.description: Total number of packets received with errors which prevented those packets from being delivered.

Discard_Packets_Sent.label: Discard Packets Sent
Discard_Packets_Sent.description: Count of valid outbound packets intentionally discarded without transmission, for example a packet may be discarded to manage buffer space.

Discard_Packets_Received.label: Discard Packets Received
Discard_Packets_Received.description: Count of valid packets received and intentionally discarded without delivery to the system, for example a packet may be discarded to manage buffer space.

Vendor_specific_extensions.label: Vendor specific extensions
Vendor_specific_extensions.description: Links to a vendor specific object.
